title: S-LoRA dynamic-load registry — 13 per-domain LoRA adapters serving from one base model
rationale: Each of the 13 domain chats fine-tunes its own LoRA on its domain corpus. Without S-LoRA (Sheng 2024) you'd need 13 base-model checkpoints in GPU memory — infeasible. S-LoRA holds one base + N small adapters and swaps adapters per request. Critical for fleet-wide serving from a single qwen2.5-coder:7b base.

units.title: Adapter file format spec (safetensors r=16, alpha=32, target_modules canonical)
Inference router — route(domain) → load adapter → serve query → return
Unified-paging memory allocator (compact adapter weights into GPU page-aligned blocks)
Benchmark — 13 adapters loaded, serve cross-domain query, latency p95 < 500ms

exit_gate.thirteen_adapters_loaded: all 13 domain LoRAs simultaneously resident on a single base
exit_gate.memory_fit: total VRAM use < base + 13 * 256MB (typical LoRA size)

summary: Dynamic-load LoRA adapter stack. One base model + 13 domain adapters resident, swap per request. Foundation for serving the full-fleet self-improving loop from a single GPU.
references: Sheng et al. 2024 — S-LoRA: Serving Thousands of Concurrent LoRA Adapters
